key.decision_why: The author answered both of the triager's follow-up asks in the PR body and asked for another review, so a maintainer needs to see this, but the approach and the single commit are unchanged, so the first card still holds.
key.action_why: On 2026-09-07 laurynmm removed "not ready", added "maintainer review" and assigned pratik-pc, noting it may still need more screenshots; the later close came after pratik-pc and Karl Stolley found the issue was likely already fixed by #35691.
changed: Added before/after screenshots of long topic names, with and without emoji, at the default 16px font, including a two-line clamped row.
Added before/after screenshots of the same long-topic view with the app font size set to 20px, showing that the spacing scales (5.14px to 7.14px).
No code changes: the head commit is the same as when the feedback was given.
still_missing: No before screenshot actually shows the emoji clipping bug; the author says the pair was taken at DPR 1, where the clipping does not show, so the screenshots show the added spacing but not the fix.
key.reply_ask: Thank the author for adding the long-topic and font-size screenshots and say the PR is moving to maintainer review, noting that a before screenshot that reproduces the clipping would show the fix works.

must_have.fact: Says the author covered both follow-up asks: long topic names with and without emoji, and a different app font size (20px).
Recommends moving the PR to maintainer review with a left-sidebar CSS reviewer such as Pratik Chanda (pratik-pc) or Karl Stolley.
Notes that the before screenshots, taken at DPR 1, do not reproduce the emoji clipping, so they do not prove the change fixes the reported bug.
Notes that the answer is in the PR description and comment only, with no new push: the code is the same single commit.
Mentions that others (e.g. ravisharma-09, and Karl Stolley earlier) could not reproduce the clipping on current main, so the bug may no longer occur.
